comparison.objective: Couple two color-matched tractor air lines to trailer glad hands, not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Opposes hose spring force, aligns seal faces, compresses seals, and quarter-turn locks two couplings.
comparison.success_condition: Both correct-color pairs locked near their stops, seals compressed, lines not overstretched, released and still versus post-adjustment impact performance.
comparison.reason: Although it includes push-and-turn locking under force, it tests paired fluid-coupling assembly rather than adjustable-response commissioning.
